title: Reading Drill — Checking the Depth of a Stream
description: One short passage, five questions. Recommended time: 8 minutes.

passages.title: Checking the Depth of a Stream
passages.body:
**A** A class compared water depth at three parts of a stream. One pupil chose the deepest point at each site, while another used the same position relative to a marker post.

**B** The results were hard to compare because the two approaches answered different questions. The class agreed to use a fixed measuring position and record the deepest point separately.

**C** A later group repeated the readings after a storm. It measured from the same markers and noted where gravel had moved, since erosion could expose more of a measuring rod.
